preconditions.description: The size of the set n is between 5 and b, inclusive, and both are between 5 and 10000.
The size of the set n is divisible by 5.
The number of hints q is between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= upToi <= b and 0 <= quantityi <= n for upToi, quantityi in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint consists of upToi between 1 and b, and quantityi between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'fair' if any(set_ for set_ in possible_sets if all(len([x for x in set_ if x <= upToi]) == quantityi for upToi, quantityi in hints)) else return_value == 'unfair'
postconditions.description: The output is 'fair' if there exists at least one set satisfying all conditions and matching all hints; otherwise, it is 'unfair'.
